entries.title: I Chronicles 29:9

segments: ¶Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed [be] thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:18
segments: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee: {prepare: or, stablish}

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:19

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:20
segments: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD, and the king.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:21
segments: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD, on the morrow after that day, [even] a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, [and] a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:26
segments: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:27
segments: And the time that he reigned over Israel [was] forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three [years] reigned he in Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:28
segments: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:29

segments: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
